name: AccioJob
long_description:
AccioJob is an offline-first tech skilling and placement institute. We run
physical skill centres in Noida, Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai alongside an
online programme, training graduates in Data Analytics, Data Science & AI and AI Engineering with Full Stack. 2,000+ students placed across 500+ hiring
partners, with 50+ hiring drives run every month.
one_liner: Offline-first tech skilling and placement for India
